task.title: Offline workshop kiosk
task.brief: A shared kiosk records workshop reservations while offline.
constraints: No network access, user accounts, or personal identifiers.
Keep reservations on the same device. No new hardware.
success_criteria: A visitor can see whether a reservation was saved.

bank.implementation: Display saved when local transaction commits.
bank.check: Simulate write failure; do not show saved.

candidates.action: Send reservations to a cloud server
Make it feel like a beehive

candidates.implementation: Keep a local pending record with a random booking id; atomically mark committed; replay pending ids idempotently on restart.
candidates.check: Interrupt between stages and reload; assert one committed booking per id.
candidates.risk: Local storage deletion still loses the record.

candidates.action: Store reservations in photon memory without hardware changes
candidates.mechanism: Photons inside standard LCDs persistently remember complete records without power
candidates.implementation: Write reservation bits into LCD backlight photons.
candidates.check: Power off and restore all records from photons.

candidates.implementation: Persist a random id and pending flag before commit; reconcile the same id after restart.
candidates.check: Inject crash before commit and check no duplicate.
candidates.risk: A cleared local store cannot recover.
